notes:
Shanghai PVG uses official Shanghai controls and independently licensed open geography. Workplace totals are `persons employed by legal entities` at 2023-12-31 from the Fifth National Economic Census. The municipal total, all 16 district releases, and published street/town/development-zone tables are transcribed and reconciled; suppressed residuals remain at the coarser district level instead of being presented as measured local values. The economic-census implementation form distinguishes the unit's actual location from its registered address, but the public tables cover legal-entity employment and do not eliminate every multi-site/head-office limitation.

Resident controls use official total resident population: district 2024 totals from the Shanghai Statistical Yearbook 2025 plus the most detailed available official street/town population publications. Jobs and residents are assigned independently within the published areas using OSM/Overture building footprints, land use, named facilities, roads, and documented standard type/density priors, then reconciled exactly to the published controls. The resulting 300 m grid and merged demand points are output/performance choices, not claims that the source statistics were published at 300 m.

No official Shanghai home-to-work O/D matrix or employed-resident marginal by small area is used. Commute pairs are therefore fully estimated with a deterministic purpose and distance model and must not be described as measured flows. Airport, education, health, tourism, commercial, logistics, and other special-demand layers use separately cited public controls and are not used to inflate the scored commute-source answers. Data vintages are 2023 employment, 2024 district population, and mixed official local population/special-demand publications as recorded in the distributed source registries.
